``` bash
$ hexo new "My New Post"
```

More info: [Writing](https://hexo.io/docs/writing.html)

### Run server

``` bash
$ hexo server
```

More info: [Server](https://hexo.io/docs/server.html)

### Generate static files

``` bash
$ hexo generate
```

More info: [Generating](https://hexo.io/docs/generating.html)

### Deploy to remote sites

$ hexo deploy
```

More info: [Deployment](https://hexo.io/docs/one-command-deployment.html)

# About Me

Hello! My name is **Wanbang Zhong**.

I am a Ph.D. candidate in **[Your Department]** at **[Your University]**, focusing on **computational electromagnetics, numerical modeling, and plasma physics simulations**. My research combines advanced numerical methods and high-fidelity modeling to study complex electromagnetic phenomena in extreme environments.

From **[Start Month–End Month, Year]**, I worked as a research intern at **[Company/Institution]**, where I contributed to **[specific task/project, e.g., high-frequency antenna design and simulation optimization]**.

I received my bachelor’s degree in **[Your Major]** from **[Your University]** in **[Month, Year]**, graduating with **[honors/awards if applicable]**.

---

## 🔬 Research Overview

My research focuses on developing and implementing **advanced numerical solvers** for electromagnetic and plasma systems, including:

* **FDTD** (Finite-Difference Time-Domain) methods
* **TCAD-based multiphysics modeling**
* **Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs)**

I aim to bridge **theory and practical applications** in areas such as **satellite communications, high-speed electronics, and plasma-enabled devices**.
